test_title: PYST 29 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 22 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Choose the best option to replace the underlined part to improve the given sentence. If no substitution is required, select 'No substitution.'

My sister is very __good at children.__
solution:
The correct answer is '**2**' i.e. 'Good with children'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The phrase "**good with children**" is the correct usage to describe someone who interacts well and is skilled at dealing with children.
